apihelp-createapage-summary: CreateAPage API module: hel HTML-ka createplate-ka oo maamul u beddelashada habka tifaftirka wikitext-ka caadiga ah ee Special:CreatePage
apihelp-createapage-param-template: Magaca createplate la soo shubayo marka halbeegga <kbd>what</kbd> loo dejiyo <kbd>multieditparse</kbd>
apihelp-createapage-param-what: Magaca ficilka la qaadayo, oo noqon kara <kbd>multieditparse</kbd> ama <kbd>switchtoadvancedediting</kbd> midkood
apihelp-createapage-example-1: Hel HTML-ka (ma aha wikitext-ka) ee <kbd>MediaWiki:Createplate-Actor</kbd> '''kaliya u isticmaal Special:CreatePage!'''
apihelp-createapage-example-2: Ku kaydi wikitext-ka asalka ah ee uu isticmaaluhu bixiyay, oo aan wax laga beddelin (CreateAPage), superglobal-ka PHP $_SESSION['article_content'] si loogu sii isticmaalo
apihelp-createapage-upload-summary: Module-ka API-ga soo gelinta sawirrada ee CreateAPage
apihelp-createapage-upload-param-num: Aqoonsiyaha tirooyinka ah ee foomka soo gelinta marka createplate leeyahay goobo badan oo soo gelin ah; kan waa in la isticmaalaa, laakiin waxaan u malaynayaa in koodhku adeegsado <kbd>wpPostFix</kbd> sababo aan ii caddayn (tusaale ahaan, ''maxay'' ''u'' ''isticmaali'' ''waayeen'' halbeegga <kbd>num</kbd> marka la qeexay, balse ''ay'' '''qasab''' ''uga dhigayaan'' halbeegga in loo qeexo <kbd>wpPostFix</kbd>?). Hagaajinnada koodhka waa la soo dhoweynayaa!
apihelp-createapage-upload-param-infix: Waa in la isticmaalaa laakiin... lama isticmaalo; sabab aan la garanayn awgeed koodhka PHP ee soo gelintu wuxuu kaa filayaa inaad dejiso <kbd>wpInFix</kbd> beddelkeeda, mana aanan awoodin inaan ogaado sababta. Hagaajinnada koodhka waa la soo dhoweynayaa!
apihelp-createapage-upload-param-comment: Farriinta kooban ee soo gelinta; haddii aan la dejin, waxay si caadi ah ugu noqonaysaa qiimaha <kbd>MediaWiki:Createpage-uploaded-from</kbd>
createpage-desc: [[Special:CreatePage|Is dhexgal fudud oo loo isticmaalo abuurista maqaallo cusub]]
createpage-title-additional: Waxaad raacday isku xir u gudbinaya bog aan weli jirin. Si aad u abuurto bogga, ku bilow qorista sanduuqa hoose.
createpage-article-exists: Maqaalkani hore ayuu u jiray. Wax ka beddel
createpage-advanced-warning: Beddelidda hababka tifaftirka waxay khalkhal gelin kartaa qaabka bogga, ma rabtaa inaad sii waddo?
createpage-login-warning: Haddii aad hadda soo gasho, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad lumiso dhammaan qoraalkaaga aan la kaydin. Ma rabtaa inaad sii waddo?
createpage-title-check-text: Ma samayn kartid ficil ilaa hubinta cinwaanku dhammaato. Fadlan mar kale guji badhanka ficilka si aad u sii waddo.
createpage-img-uploaded: Sawirka si guul leh ayaa loo soo geliyey
createpage-preview-end: Dhammaadka horudhaca. Waxaad hoos ka sii wadan kartaa tifaftirkaaga:
createpage-login-required: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad soo gasho si aad sawirro u soo geliso
createpage-upload-directory-read-only: Hagaha soo gelintu ma laha oggolaansho qoraal oo uu webserver-ku isticmaali karo
createpage-about-info: Kani waa tifaftiraha la fududeeyey. Si aad wax badan uga ogaato, tag [[s:Help:CreatePage|ShoutWiki Hub]].
createpage-unsaved-changes-details: Waxaad haysataa isbeddello aan la kaydin. Gujinta OK waxay keeni doontaa in laga tago.
tog-createpage-redlinks: Isticmaal [http://www.shoutwiki.com/wiki/Help:CreatePage CreatePage] marka aad raacayso isku xirro jaban
